 Print JEE Main 2027 Session 1 registration The National Testing Agency (NTA) will close the registration process for the Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) Main 2027 Session 1 in three days. Candidates who have not yet submitted their application forms can complete the process through the official website, jeemain.nta.nic.in. According to the latest figures, the NTA has received 10,47,083 registration forms for JEE Main 2027 Session 1. However, only 8,38,138 candidates have completed the fee payment process so far. The last date to submit the application form is November 22, 2026, until 11:50 pm. Candidates who miss the deadline will get another opportunity to apply by paying a late fee of Rs 500. The late fee application window will remain open from November 23 to November 26, 2026, until 11:50 pm. Steps to apply for JEE Main 2027

 Candidates can follow these steps to complete their JEE Main 2027 Session 1 registration: Visit the official website, jeemain.nta.nic.in.
 On the homepage, click on the JEE Main 2027 Session 1 registration link.
 Select new registration and choose a login option through DigiLocker, e-Pramaan or JanParichay under Meri Pehchaan.
 Enter the required personal details, mobile number and email address.
 Fill in the academic details and select the examination paper and preferred examination cities.
 Upload the photograph, signature and other required documents.
 Pay the application fee and submit the form.
 Download the confirmation page for future reference.
 Direct link here. JEE Main 2027 application correction window
 The NTA will open the JEE Main 2027 Session 1 application correction window from November 27 to November 29, 2026. During this period, registered candidates will be allowed to edit permitted details in their submitted application forms. Candidates should review their information carefully and make the necessary corrections within the given deadline. JEE Advanced 2027 exam date
 The Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Delhi will conduct the JEE Advanced 2027 examination on May 23, 2027. The institute has also launched the official website for the examination at jeeadv.ac.in. The new website provides eligibility criteria and other relevant information for candidates planning to appear for the engineering entrance examination. Candidates appearing for JEE Advanced 2027 will also be allowed to use an on-screen basic, non-scientific calculator with a 10- to 12-digit display.
